context.body: Genesis through Deuteronomy distinguishes requests, responses, priestly formulas, intercession, restitution, pardon, retained consequence, and stated refusal to pardon. The bounded source is Genesis 50:15–21.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Joseph’s brothers request forgiveness for their evil.
observations.label: The brothers ask; Joseph answers without a pardon formula: action

observations.body: Joseph weeps, refuses God’s place, distinguishes intentions, promises provision, comforts them without an explicit “I forgive you” formula.
observations.label: The brothers ask; Joseph answers without a pardon formula: response

payload.posture: Read Genesis 50:15–21 as requests, law, and pardon evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The brothers explicitly ask forgiveness, but Joseph answers through tears, Godward restraint, provision, and comfort rather than an explicit verbal pardon formula.
payload.title: The brothers ask; Joseph answers without a pardon formula
